description: G2 v2+ cloud GPU load (amendment A2a rule 6 and A2a-5). The competitor is the edge-load worker on the cloud GPU. C1 is the smallest E3 candidate (C10 and C15 added by A2a-4) whose median cloud server time is 1.4-1.6x the C0 median: C50, 1.46x. C2 (A2a-5) is the smallest of C75/C100 whose cloud/raw_image median at 35/20 is within 10% of the same run's edge/full median: C100, -3.4% (C75 was -40%). Calibrated in phase E on 18 November 2026.
